title: Head of Quality Engineering
text:
**Location: St. Paul, MN | Columbia, MD | Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)**

In this position, you'll be based in one of the listed office locations for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex.

**We give you a world of potential**

Technology plays a critical role in helping Computershare deliver secure, resilient, and innovative solutions for clients around the world. Within our Corporate Trust technology organization, we're investing in the future of quality engineering and building a modern, engineering-led approach to quality that is deeply embedded within the software development lifecycle.

We're looking for a strategic and transformational Head of Quality Engineering to lead the evolution of quality engineering across Corporate Trust Technology. This role will define the quality engineering vision, operating model, standards, tooling, governance, and automation strategy while partnering closely with engineering, product, architecture, security, and business leaders.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering across a global technology organization, lead large distributed teams, and drive the adoption of automation-first and AI-assisted testing practices at scale.

**A role you will love**

As the Head of Quality Engineering, you'll be responsible for establishing and executing the quality engineering strategy across Corporate Trust Technology. You'll help transform quality from a traditional quality assurance function into an engineering-led discipline focused on automation, continuous testing, risk reduction, and delivery excellence.

This role is ideal for a technology leader who enjoys influencing at scale, driving organizational change, building high-performing teams, and improving engineering outcomes across multiple delivery organizations.

**Other key responsibilities include:**

* Defining and executing the quality engineering vision, strategy, and operating model across Corporate Trust Technology.
* Leading quality engineering transformation initiatives and organizational change efforts.
* Driving automation-first testing strategies and Playwright adoption.
* Establishing enterprise quality standards, governance frameworks, policies, and reporting practices.
* Defining quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and continuous improvement processes.
* Leading and developing globally distributed quality engineering teams across onshore and offshore locations.
* Sponsoring adoption of AI-assisted testing, quality analytics, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Providing executive oversight of quality outcomes, delivery risk, defect trends, and production incidents.
* Partnering with engineering, product, architecture, risk, compliance, and security teams to align quality practices with business objectives.
Building sustainable quality engineering capabilities through coaching, workforce planning, learning pathways, and succession planning. 

**What will you bring to the role?**

Required:

* Enterprise-scale quality engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading quality engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong automation expertise, particularly with Playwright.
* Experience establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and engineering best practices.
* Experience supporting Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery environments.
* Experience managing global and offshore technology teams.
* Strong understanding of test automation, quality engineering frameworks, software delivery lifecycle governance, and continuous testing practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior technology and business stakeholders. 

Preferred:

* QA-to-QE transformation experience.
* AI-assisted testing experience.
* Financial services technology experience.
* Experience leading Centers of Excellence or shared services organizations.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, Veracode, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise modernization or digital transformation programs.
Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. 

**Rewards designed for you**

**Paid parental leave,** flexible working and a caring and inclusive culture.

**Health and wellbeing rewards** that can be tailored to support you and your family, including medical, dental and vision.

**Invest in your future** with 401k matching and tax-advantaged flexible spending plans, including healthcare, dependent care and commuter.

**Income protection** . Our package includes short and long-term disability benefits, life insurance and supplemental life insurance.

**Compensation:** The typical base pay range for this role is $124,568.00 - 155,000.00 for Columbia, MD and St Paul, MN. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

**And more.** Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub .

***This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.***

*Expected application deadline: 12/07/2026.*

*AI Statement*

*Computershare will use data analytics and artificial intelligence systems to help recruiters analyse and assess candidate and application information. These systems make our application and review process more efficient and assist our team in identifying candidates based on professional qualifications, skills and experience commensurate with the role applied for. All outputs from these systems are evaluated by our recruiters and are not the sole source of whether to consider a candidate for employment.*
